speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the emergency room. I am Dr. Agent; to begin my assessment of your newborn's respiratory distress, please tell me how many hours old your baby is and if they have any birth defects or complications during delivery. Also, have you noticed any fever, cyanosis (bluish skin), or grunting sounds while breathing?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born after the 32nd gestational week. The baby was born via cesarean delivery. The mother had gestational diabetes but was otherwise healthy with no other pregnancy-related diseases.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) secondary to prematurity (32 weeks gestation) and maternal gestational diabetes.

I have established the baby is premature and born via C-section, which are risk factors for RDS. Given the history, do you observe the classic signs of RDS such as grunting, nasal flaring, or retractions?
